criteria.question: Can one run, wave, worker, result, validator, and terminal decision be traversed as a linked trace without raw prompts?
Can run/wave/worker/provider/model/effort usage, cost, latency, residual count, and denial reason be filtered and aggregated?
Can sanitized fixtures and validator outcomes be stored, versioned, compared, and evaluated without importing customer content?
Does the deployed route preserve AgentFanout allowlist sanitization, avoid prompt/tool-output export, and fail closed on unsafe configuration?
Can retention, deletion, storage growth, and a hard capacity limit be evidenced and operated privately?
Can local CPU/memory/disk/network dependency, upgrades, backup, and recovery be operated at the intended scale?
Can AgentFanout emit required data through a small, version-pinned adapter without duplicating control-plane authority?
